snippet.description:
The French Interior Minister has warned of a “long and very difficult battle” against a fire raging in southwestern France. Spain has declared its first ever national emergency over a wildfire. And the Scottish government has asked for aerial support from the UK military to boost the response to a major fire in the Highlands.

[Subscribe to our Substack newsletter: https://channel4news.substack.com/subscribe]

Scottish police declared a major incident after a change in wind conditions accelerated the fire in the Cairngorms National Park, prompting the evacuation of local residents as a precaution.

Meanwhile on mainland Europe, the rapid spread of wildfires is causing devastation and upheaval.

Across Sicily, Firefighters are tackling numerous individual blazes. A major fire west of the Spanish capital Madrid has already forced 70,000 people to leave their homes.

In southwest France the government has now sent soldiers in to help battle a massive fire, which this morning forced the evacuations of some residents in the suburbs of Bordeaux.

snippet.title: High-Protein Air Fryer Chicken Fried Rice | Easy Meal Prep #highprotein #cooking
snippet.description:
Want chicken fried rice without standing over a skillet? This High-Protein Air Fryer Chicken Fried Rice is an easy 4-serving meal prep loaded with chicken, jasmine rice, eggs, vegetables, and classic fried-rice flavor.

Makes 4 Servings

Per Serving:
Calories: ~560
Protein: ~60g
Carbohydrates: ~50g
Fat: ~13g

Ingredients:

• 2 lb boneless skinless chicken breast
• 2 large eggs
• 500g cooked jasmine rice
• 10 oz frozen mixed vegetables
• 3 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce
• 3 tbsp oyster sauce
• 1 tbsp + 1 tsp sesame oil
• 3 green onions
• 1 tbsp Famous Dave’s Chicken Rub
• 1 tsp garlic powder
• ½ tsp black pepper
• Avocado oil cooking spray

Instructions:
Dice and season the chicken, then air fry at 400°F for 8–10 minutes, tossing halfway through. Add the cooked rice, frozen vegetables, soy sauce, oyster sauce, sesame oil, and green onions. Crack in 2 eggs and mix everything together. Air fry for another 7–9 minutes at 400°F, stirring halfway through, until the eggs are cooked, the rice begins to crisp, and the chicken reaches 165°F internally. Divide evenly into 4 meal-prep containers.

snippet.title: 10 Canned Foods That Last 30+ Years (Most Preppers Don't Know #7)
snippet.description:
Most people throw away food that is still perfectly safe to eat 🥫 And the reason is surprisingly simple — many date labels are designed for inventory management and product quality, not necessarily for food safety. That misunderstanding leads to massive food waste, unnecessary spending, and poorly planned emergency food storage.

Here’s the thing — not all shelf-stable foods are created equal. While many canned products last only a few years, certain commercially packaged foods can remain usable for decades when stored correctly. Long-term food storage is less about expiration dates and more about temperature, packaging, oxygen exposure, moisture levels, and food chemistry.

What most people miss is that a successful emergency food supply isn’t just about calories. Protein, fats, carbohydrates, vitamins, minerals, and even food variety all matter. A stockpile built only around rice and beans may provide energy, but it can still leave major nutritional gaps over time.

The reality is that food security isn't about fear — it's about preparation. Understanding how long food actually lasts can help families reduce waste, save money, and build a more reliable long-term food reserve.

Disclaimer: This video is for educational and informational purposes only. Always inspect food for signs of spoilage and follow manufacturer guidelines before consumption. Storage conditions greatly affect actual shelf life.

What most people miss is that a successful emergency food supply isn’t just about calories. Protein, fats, carbohydrates, vitamins, minerals, and even food variety all matter. A stockpile built only around rice and beans may provide energy, but it can still leave major nutritional gaps over time.

The reality is that food security isn't about fear — it's about preparation. Understanding how long food actually lasts can help families reduce waste, save money, and build a more reliable long-term food reserve.

snippet.title: China's Earthquake-Proof Buildings: 😱🏢The Technology That Saves Cities" #shorts
snippet.description:
China's Earthquake-Proof Buildings: 😱🏢The Technology That Saves Cities" #shorts 


China is rewriting the rules of earthquake safety.
After the recent 7.7 magnitude earthquake in Thailand, the world is once again reminded of how devastating seismic disasters can be. But in China, a groundbreaking solution is already in place – Seismic Base Isolation Technology.

Instead of connecting buildings directly to the ground, engineers place giant rubber bearings, shock absorbers, and dampers under the structures. When the earth shakes, these systems absorb the energy, keeping the building perfectly balanced and stable.

From skyscrapers in Shanghai to hospitals in Chengdu and even massive bridges, China is rapidly applying this technology to safeguard millions of lives. With this innovation, buildings can withstand even earthquakes of magnitude 8 and above without collapsing.

While countries like Japan and the USA have used similar systems, China has implemented it on a mega scale, making its cities far safer than many others around the world. In contrast, India’s earthquake-prone regions like Delhi, Guwahati, and Dehradun still rely on traditional construction methods, which makes them far more vulnerable.

This video explores:

The science behind Seismic Base Isolation

How China is protecting its cities from deadly earthquakes

Real examples of earthquake-resistant hospitals, schools, and bridges

snippet.title: Doomsday Cheat Sheet Every Marvel Fan Needs
snippet.description:
Avengers: Doomsday releases December 18, 2026, and Marvel Studios just dropped an official 15-title watchlist to prepare for the film. If your bro, girlfriend, sibling, or MCU-curious friend hasn’t caught up, they will spend the entire theatrical experience whispering “Bro how is he alive?” every ten minutes.

Here is the essential Doomsday prep cheat sheet you can send them right now.

The essential viewing list:

1. Doctor Strange: Multiverse of Madness (2022) — The first official MCU multiverse exploration. Establishes the incursion concept, features Patrick Stewart’s Professor X cameo, and reveals that MCU universes can be destroyed by multiversal collision.

2. Loki Season 1 and Season 2 — Explains the TVA (Time Variance Authority), how the multiverse mechanically works, timeline branching, and most importantly, why Loki now sits on the Yggdrasil throne holding all branching timelines together with his own power. Loki is the ONLY reason the multiverse is stable enough for Doomsday to happen at all.

3. Avengers: Endgame (2019) — The Infinity Saga’s emotional payoff. Also essential for one specific reason: Steve Rogers goes back in time to be with Peggy Carter at the end. His return in Doomsday only makes sense if you understand his happy-ending choice.

4. The Marvels post-credits scene (2023) — The first real Doomsday breadcrumb. Kelsey Grammer’s Beast appears in a multiversal moment that sets up his Doomsday return.

5. Fantastic Four: First Steps (2025) — Introduces the MCU’s Fantastic Four (Reed, Sue, Johnny, Ben), Galactus, and most critically, Robert Downey Jr’s Doctor Doom appears in the mid-credits scene looming over Franklin Richards. This is Doom’s MCU debut.

6. Thunderbolts (2025) — Introduces Sentry (Lewis Pullman) and forms the New Avengers team going into Doomsday. Yelena Belova, Bucky Barnes, John Walker, Ghost, Red Guardian, and Sentry are all Doomsday-critical characters.

7. Spider-Man: Brand New Day (2026) — Peter Parker’s current status after Doctor Strange erased his identity from the world. Also features Cindy Moon setup (Silk), Sadie Sink’s Jean Grey, and the post-credits scene showing Peter pulled to space (potentially by Doom).

8. Original X-Men (2000) and X2: X-Men United (2003) — Essential Fox X-Men context. Patrick Stewart’s Professor X, Ian McKellen’s Magneto, James Marsden’s Cyclops, Rebecca Romijn’s Mystique, Alan Cumming’s Nightcrawler, and Kelsey Grammer’s Beast are all returning. Your bro needs to understand who these characters are before Doomsday.
